POST auth-login: Sign in: `{"email", "password"}` → `{"status": "ok", "me"}` or `{"status": "2fa_required"}`. Wrong passwords lock the account after 5 tries; 20 failures from one address in 15 minutes → 429.
POST auth-password: Change your own password: `{"current_password", "new_password"}` (at least 12 characters).
POST auth-password-reset: Ask for a reset link by email: `{"email"}`. Always answers ok; sends nothing without SMTP.
POST auth-password-reset-confirm: Set a new password with the emailed link: `{"agency", "user", "token", "new_password"}`.
POST auth-2fa-enable: Turn on two-step sign-in with a code from the app: `{"code"}` → one-time recovery codes.
GET me: The signed-in user: name, agency, roles, whether they are agency administrator, licence status.
GET users: Users of the agency with their access (agency administrator).
POST users: Add a user: `{"email", "full_name", "assignments": [{"office_id", "level"}]}` → a temporary password, shown once.
PATCH user: Change a user: `{"full_name"}`, `{"is_active": false}` to deactivate (the last administrator cannot be).
PATCH role-assignment: Change the level of one access: `{"level"}`.
DELETE role-assignment: Remove one access (not the last agency administrator).
GET support-grants: Active support grants: platform-owner staff allowed to look at this agency's data.
POST support-grants: Let vendor support look at the agency for a time: `{"platform_admin_email", "hours", "reason"}`.
GET levels: Names of the structure's levels (e.g. Ministry, Service, Division).
GET office: One office with its place in the tree.
PATCH office: Rename or recode an office, or set `{"is_active"}`.
DELETE office: Delete an office that has no history (otherwise deactivate it).
POST office-move: Move an office and everything beneath it: `{"parent_id"}`.
GET groups: Office groups (sets of offices compared in rankings).
PATCH group: Rename a group or change its order.
DELETE group: Delete a group (the offices are not affected).
GET audit-log: Audit log, newest first; filters `from`, `to`, `actor`, `action`, `office`, `entity_type`; paging with `before`.
GET audit-log-row: One audit row with its before/after values.
POST fiscal-years: Create a fiscal year with its twelve months: `{"label", "start_year", "preset"}`.
GET fiscal-year: One fiscal year with its months (cutoffs, locked or open) and scoring profile id.
PATCH fiscal-year: Open or close a fiscal year: `{"status": "open" | "closed"}`.
GET scoring-presets: The built-in scoring presets and what each means.
PATCH scoring-profile: Change scoring settings (`preset`, `weighting`, `cap_at_100`, `on_time_tolerance`, labels, `rollup`, `cutoff_day`, …). After a month is locked, needs `{"confirm": true}`; locked months keep their results.
GET plan: One plan version: rows (outline and activities with monthly targets), indicators, validation messages.
POST plan-submit: Submit a draft for approval (refused with the list of problems if it does not validate).
POST plan-approve: Approve a submitted plan (agency administrator); it becomes the baseline and supersedes the previous version.
POST plan-return: Return a submitted plan to its office: `{"note"}`.
POST plan-revise: Start a revision of the approved plan (a new draft version).
GET plan-versions: Every version of a plan with who submitted and approved it.
GET dashboard: Dashboard of one office for one month: `?office&period[&view=implementing]` → figures, curves, quarters, children, rankings, FINAL or PROVISIONAL.
GET reports: Monthly report of one office: `?office&period[&view]` → activities with targets and accomplishments, indicators, submission status, live result.
POST reports-submit: Submit an office's month: `{"office", "period"}` (refused while delay reasons or required files are missing).
POST reports-return: Return a submitted month to its office: `{"office", "period", "note"}` (agency administrator).
DELETE attachment: Remove a supporting file (kept in storage for the audit trail).
GET job: One export or import job: status, result summary, `download_url` when done.
GET notifications-unread: Number of unread notifications (send `X-Background: 1` when polling).
GET health: Liveness and readiness: database, storage, worker heartbeat, deployment mode. No sign-in.
